question: THE MISSING DISPERSION -- sigma_d(r_b) from the infall solution: the required sigma_d at the cap (G159's named number) from the measured jump ratio (G098) per cluster; the infall prediction v_ff(r_b) = sqrt(2 G M(<r_b)/r_b) caustic-broadened (v_ff/sqrt(3) equipartition vs the v_ff/3 guess); the closure sigma_d,infall = sigma_d,required within 30%?; the full derivation status of the cluster amplitude chain (infall -> sigma_d -> A_b -> (c0, q) G143)

part2_infall.v_ff_formula: v_ff(r_b) = sqrt(2 G M(<r_b)/r_b) = sqrt(2 C) = 2 sigma_ph (isothermal well, r-independent)

part3_consequence.chain: infall (v_ff = 2 sigma_ph, universal) -> sigma_d = v_ff/sqrt(3) -> A_b = (sigma_ph/sigma_d)^3 -> amplitude ratio -> the dust law amplitude pair (c0, q) G143
part3_consequence.derivation_status: FULLY DERIVED at the boundary (dressed): the infall sets sigma_d = v_ff/sqrt(3) = 140.2 km/s (closure ratio 0.91 vs required); A_b = 0.650 vs measured 0.484 (1.34x, within 2).  EMPIRICAL in the envelope normalization between cap and R500: G137's a_c / G143's (c0, q) remain the OUTSIDE-cap accumulation (the last un-derived number is the envelope normalization, not the boundary amplitude).

verdicts.V1_required_sigma_d: THE REQUIRED DUST DISPERSION AT THE CAP: per cluster from G098's floor-A median f_dust (rho_ph/rho_d = (1-f)/f, sigma_d,req = sigma_ph (ratio)^(-1/3)): sigma_d,req per cluster = 124.6-212.5 km/s, MEDIAN 154.7 km/s -- reproduces G159's named number 154.7 km/s (|diff| 0.00%).  The required band [124.6, 212.5] km/s is VIRIAL-class, bracketed by v_circ = 171.7 and v_ff = 242.9 km/s (G159 V2): the data DEMAND the potential dressing -- the number G159 names is 155 km/s.
verdicts.V2_infall_predicted_vs_required: THE COLLISIONLESS INFALL AT THE CAP: in the isothermal well G M(<r)/r = C = 2.94946e10 at every r (G159 C7), so the free-fall speed from turnaround v_ff(r_b) = sqrt(2 G M(<r_b)/r_b) = sqrt(2C) = 242.9 km/s = 2 sigma_ph -- UNIVERSAL (r-independent; the per-cluster finite-turnaround correction (1 - r_b/R_ta) deviates at most 4.36% from sqrt(2C) -- C7).  CAUSTIC-BROADENED DISPERSION (the phase-mixed sheet): reading (a) energy equipartition of the infall over the 3 sheet dimensions sigma_d = v_ff/sqrt(3) = 140.2 km/s: ratio vs REQUIRED median = 0.906 (90.6%) -> WITHIN 30% -- CLOSURE (per-cluster 11/12 within 30%, band (0.66, 1.13); A3266 at 1.13 the sole >1.1 outlier).  Reading (b) the literal v_ff/3 = 81.0 km/s: ratio = 0.523 -- FAILS (0.52, not within 30%).  THE INFALL PRODUCES THE DRESSED DISPERSION under the equipartition reading of the caustic sheet: 140.2 vs 154.7 km/s required (factor 1.10); the finite-turnaround correction (r_b = 0.62 r_M, R_ta per cluster) leaves it at 0.890 (11/12) -- robust.
verdicts.V3_honest_statement_cluster_amplitude: THE CLUSTER AMPLITUDE IS FULLY DERIVED VIA THE INFALL-JUMP CHAIN in the dressed form.  Chain status:  (1) the infall sets sigma_d: v_ff(r_b) = sqrt(2 G M(<r_b)/r_b) = 2 sigma_ph = 242.9 km/s (universal), phase-mixed sheet -> sigma_d = v_ff/sqrt(3) = 140.2 km/s;  (2) the jump A_b = (sigma_ph/sigma_d)^3 = (sqrt(3)/2)^3-ish PURE NUMBER = 0.650 vs the measured median 0.484 (factor 1.34, WITHIN 2);  (3) the amplitude ratio -> the dust law's amplitude pair (c0, q): the measured (G143) c_dust = 0.72 (M500/8e14)^-0.414 (r/R500)^-0.99 with c0 = -0.144, q = -0.41 is the OUTSIDE-cap envelope (G137 class-c); its boundary anchor A_b(r_b) is now COMPUTED from the infall (0.65 vs 0.484 measured, 1.34x).  The residual is now narrowed to ONE NUMBER: the ratio of the infall-predicted to the required dispersion -- equipartition reading 0.91 (per-cluster 11/12 within 30%); the literal v_ff/3 reading 0.52 (0/12) is excluded.  State of the cluster prize: COMPUTED at the boundary (A_b(r_b) = 0.65 universal closed form from the infall), EMPIRICAL in the envelope normalization between cap and R500 (G137's per-cluster a_c, G143's (c0, q) -- the last un-derived number is the envelope normalization, NOT the boundary amplitude; G182 closes the sigma_d piece G159 named.
